request: Preserve adopted LibraryGold sidebar and add one variation with generated freestanding gold icons without square frames.

assets.referenceRole: Existing framed icon: central object, gold/black materials, soft 3D perspective and lighting; outer badge removed
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied icon image into ONE freestanding, unframed sidebar icon: wallet with a star coin and a downward arrow for deposit.
Reference role: preserve the existing central object's subject, recognizable silhouette, front-facing soft 3D perspective, polished champagne-gold metal, warm highlights, dark metallic recesses, bevel detail and top-left studio lighting.
Remove the ENTIRE external rounded-square button/tile: its gold perimeter rim, black backplate, corner frame and all behind-object panel surfaces. Reconstruct any object edges hidden by that outer tile.
Keep only the central wallet with a star coin and a downward arrow for deposit and its intrinsic parts, floating on a genuinely transparent background. Intrinsic object geometry such as a book cover, wallet body or slot machine casing is allowed; an external square/round badge, app-icon container or backing plate is forbidden.
Centered isolated object with approximately 80% canvas occupancy and transparent breathing room on every edge. Preserve the same series material and lighting; make the silhouette readable at a 28px sidebar display size. No scene, no ground plane, no enclosing shape, no pedestal added, no background shadow rectangle, no text, no watermark. Do not replace this with a flat line/vector icon.
Output one clean transparent PNG icon, not a sheet, collage or menu screenshot.
